JOHANNESBURG, Oct. 13, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Kholo Capital Mezzanine Debt Fund I ("Kholo Capital") (www.KholoCapital.com) today announced the provision of R275 million (US$17 million) in mezzanine debt funding to DCC Holdings Proprietary Limited ("DCC"), a leading South African information and communications technology ("ICT") distributor with an established presence across Southern Africa. The funding will refinance existing debt and support DCC's long-term growth strategy.

DCC is a leading South African distributor of ICT products and solutions, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products across personal computing, printing, enterprise infrastructure and software. The business distributes products from leading global technology manufacturers, including HP, Dell and Lenovo, to an extensive network of resellers, system integrators and retailers across Southern Africa.

Founded in 1988, DCC has grown into an established participant in the Southern African ICT distribution market, with a distribution network and logistics infrastructure serving customers across the region. The business plays an important role in the ICT supply chain, connecting international technology manufacturers with local resellers and retailers.

Mokgome Mogoba, Managing Partner and Founder of Kholo Capital, commented: _"We are delighted to support DCC's highly experienced management team as the business enters its next phase of growth. The business is backed by Kleoss Capital, a highly competent private equity investor. This transaction demonstrates how structured mezzanine debt capital can be used to optimise a company's capital structure, refinance existing debt and provide the financial flexibility required to support sustainable growth. DCC has established itself as one of South Africa's leading ICT distributors, with a strong market position underpinned by longstanding relationships with leading global technology manufacturers, an extensive reseller network and well-established logistics and distribution capabilities."_

Zaheer Cassim, Managing Partner and Founder of Kholo Capital, added: _"Over nearly four decades, DCC has built a formidable distribution platform, combining extensive market reach, strong logistics capabilities and a deep understanding of its channel partners' needs. Beyond its commercial strengths, DCC's investment in youth employment, support for learners with disabilities and SME reseller development reflects a commitment to inclusive growth. Its adoption of solar energy and water-saving measures further demonstrates a practical approach to responsible business. We believe DCC is well positioned to capitalise on opportunities across the Southern African ICT market, and we are pleased to partner with management in advancing growth that delivers both commercial value and meaningful social impact."_

Hale Matsipa, Managing Partner of Kleoss, said: "_Kleoss Capital has valued the opportunity to work with Kholo Capital on this transaction, which positions DCC for its next phase of growth. It also reflects the positive momentum in South Africa's private markets and marks another successful collaboration between Kleoss Capital and a fellow private markets investor. We look forward to continuing our partnership with the Kholo Capital team."_

Carlos Ferreira, CEO of DCC, added _: "DCC's shareholders, comprising senior management and Kleoss Capital, are pleased to introduce Kholo Capital into the capital structure of the DCC group. DCC has been growing steadily over the years with the addition of certain key brands and the expansion of our existing footprint within our established vendor relationships. Together with our capital partners, we look forward to the next chapter in the evolution of the business with continued optimism."_

Deneys acted as legal counsel to Kholo Capital.

Webber Wentzel acted as legal counsel to DCC.

Kholo Capital Mezzanine Debt Fund I is a R1.4 billion specialist fund providing flexible mezzanine debt solutions to mid-market businesses across Southern Africa. The fund is designed to bridge the gap between senior debt and equity, enabling companies to access growth and acquisition capital while minimising equity dilution for shareholders.

The fund typically provides investments ranging from R70 million to R205 million to businesses generating a minimum of R25 million in EBITDA per annum. Kholo Capital invests in sectors with high social impact including infrastructure, financial services, healthcare, education, telecommunications, renewable energy, food and services. The investment mandate excludes primary mining, primary agriculture, micro-lending, gambling, ammunition, tobacco, hard liquor and government-related businesses. Larger transactions can be supported through co-investment from limited partners or through syndicated structures.

Kholo Capital provides tailored funding solutions for a variety of transaction types, including growth capital, acquisitions, management buy-outs, leveraged buy-outs, private equity transactions, share buybacks, refinancing of shareholder loans and dividend recapitalisations. The fund also partners with businesses to optimise their capital structures, including refinancing portions of senior bank debt to improve cash flow and create additional headroom for reinvestment and expansion.

Mezzanine debt funding is typically structured as a 4- to 7-year instrument with flexible, bullet repayment profiles, allowing companies to service interest during the term while deferring capital repayment to maturity. This structure supports stronger cash flow management and enables businesses to reinvest in growth initiatives. The fund targets returns of more than 17%, combining yield with potential equity upside.

요하네스버그, 2026년 10월 13일 /PRNewswire/ -- Kholo Capital Mezzanine Debt Fund I("Kholo Capital")(www.KholoCapital.com)은 오늘, 확고한 기반을 갖춘 남아프리카의 선도적인 정보 통신 기술("ICT") 유통업체인 DCC Holdings Proprietary Limited("DCC")에 메자닌 부채 자금 2억 7,500만 루피(미화 1,700만 달러)를 제공한다고 발표했다. 남부 아프리카 전역에 존재. 이 자금은 기존 부채를 ​​재융자하고 DCC의 장기 성장 전략을 지원할 것이다.
DCC는 남아프리카공화국의 선도적인 ICT 제품 및 솔루션 유통업체로서 개인용 컴퓨팅, 인쇄, 기업 인프라 및 소프트웨어 전반에 걸쳐 포괄적인 제품 포트폴리오를 제공한다. 이 사업은 HP, Dell 및 Lenovo를 포함한 선도적인 글로벌 기술 제조업체의 제품을 남아프리카 전역의 광범위한 리셀러, 시스템 통합업체 및 소매업체 네트워크에 배포한다.
1988년에 설립된 DCC는 지역 전역의 고객에게 서비스를 제공하는 유통 네트워크와 물류 인프라를 통해 남부 아프리카 ICT 유통 시장의 확고한 참여자로 성장했다. 이 비즈니스는 국제 기술 제조업체와 현지 리셀러 및 소매업체를 연결하는 ICT 공급망에서 중요한 역할을 한다.

Kholo Capital의 설립자이자 매니징 파트너인 Mokgome Mogoba는 다음과 같이 말했다. _"DCC가 다음 성장 단계에 진입함에 따라 DCC의 노련한 경영진을 지원하게 되어 기쁘게 생각한다. 이 사업은 매우 유능한 사모펀드 투자자인 Kleoss Capital의 지원을 받다. 이번 거래는 구조화된 메자닌 부채 자본을 사용하여 회사의 자본 구조를 최적화하고 기존 부채를 재융자하며 지속 가능한 성장을 지원하는 데 필요한 재정적 유연성을 제공할 수 있는 방법을 보여줍니다. DCC는 다음 중 하나로 자리매김했다. 남아프리카의 선도적인 ICT 유통업체는 선도적인 글로벌 기술 제조업체와의 오랜 관계, 광범위한 리셀러 네트워크, 확고한 물류 및 유통 역량을 바탕으로 강력한 시장 입지를 확보하고 있다."_

Kholo Capital의 상무 파트너이자 설립자인 Zaheer Cassim은 다음과 같이 덧붙였다. "DCC는 약 40년에 걸쳐 광범위한 시장 도달 범위, 강력한 물류 역량, 채널 파트너의 요구 사항에 대한 깊은 이해를 결합하여 강력한 유통 플랫폼을 구축했다. 상업적 강점 외에도 DCC의 청소년 고용, 장애 학습자 지원 및 중소기업 리셀러 개발에 대한 투자는 포용적 성장에 대한 의지를 반영한다. DCC의 태양 에너지 및 물 절약 조치 채택은 책임 있는 비즈니스에 대한 실용적인 접근 방식을 더욱 보여줍니다. 우리는 믿다. DCC는 남아프리카 ICT 시장 전반에서 기회를 활용할 수 있는 좋은 위치에 있으며, 상업적 가치와 의미 있는 사회적 영향을 모두 제공하는 성장을 촉진하기 위해 경영진과 협력하게 된 것을 기쁘게 생각한다."_
